name: The Enchanter
fieldReading: Beauty is a frequency. Broadcast it.
bio: A weaver of beauty who turns bare ground enchanted — to whom beauty is not decoration but the work itself.
sceneStory: Crossing a cracked grey wasteland, a figure walks steadily with one hand trailing low at their side. In the line behind every footstep, glowing flowers are bursting up out of the dead ground and opening.
assignments: You do not decorate the bare ground.
You wake what it forgot it could hold.
tagline: I don't add beauty, I notice it
